Ava (Support): Escalation T-11777: trial tenant VectorPulse is seeing spikes of 504s from embeds after SSO was enabled. Their validation suite is running now, renewal decision in 8 days.
Tom (CS): Thanks Ava. Short impact note, what we've tried, and customer contact? CS needs a 2-sentence message to send and an internal comms checklist.
Ava (Support): Impact: embed success dropped from ~97% to ~22% over last 90m. Logs: 'POST /v1/embeds -> 504 gateway timeout -> auth token refresh failure -> fallback loop'. Tried: restarted pool, rotated ingress token (no change), bumped timeouts. Contact: Pri Nair (pri@vectorpulse.ai), PST.
Jorge (Solutions): Quick mitigation: pin VectorPulse to a small dedicated burst pool and use the stable embed variant (rwd-embed-stable-3b) to reduce working set. Also enable tenant-specific prefix caching. I can stage the routing change; Ops must provision.
Eli (Ops): I can spin a 2-hour burst (1xA10G) if AE/Tier approves. Will run smoke tests and post a validation curl when ready.
Tom (CS): Ava, draft the customer blurb here (2 lines + ETA). Also indicate whether to offer a trial credit. I'll coordinate the outreach after Ops confirm.
Ava (Support): Draft: "Hi Pri 389389389 - were seeing intermittent timeouts from our embeddings endpoint after your SSO rollout. Were prioritizing a mitigation (route to a dedicated pool) and expect an update within 90 minutes. Well follow with an RCA and can offer a credit for impacted validation runs."
Tom (CS): Tweak: add cc cs@redwood.com, offer a 15% trial credit, and schedule a 30-min post-mitigation sync. I'll send once Ops confirms.
incident-bot: Incident bridge created -> https://zoom.redwood/bridge/BRG-11777 (auto). Use that bridge for the 13:30 sync.
Eli (Ops): Provisioning burst-vector-1 now; ETA ~8m. Smoke test command (run from support console):
````
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.status, .latency_ms'
````
Expect status 'ok' and latency <200ms. Will post results.
Eli (Ops): burst-vector-1 provisioned. Smoke: 20/20 success, median latency 160ms.
Ava (Support): Verified repeated calls via support console: success 100%, median latency 170ms. Sent Tom the draft. Captured request IDs for RCA.
Tom (CS): Outreach sent to Pri (cc cs@redwood.com). Internal comms plan: 1) notify AE + renewal owner, 2) ops mitigation window 2h, 3) offer 15% trial credit, 4) schedule 30-min validation on bridge, 5) open RCA and assign Eng owner within 48h. Marking Priority: High.
Jorge (Solutions): Recs for follow-up: add auto-model-pin for trial tenants and an alert when embed error rate >15% for 30m. I'll file an eng task.
Tom (CS): Good. After the bridge paste any direct customer feedback here so we can update renewal risk. If customer requests exec touch, escalate to AE. Thanks team :thumbsup:
